decision_clause: Active decision within the six named paths: rule out pinning every prose field by literal digest because that duplicates the contract and makes editorial changes fail; pin only numerically fixed or derived fields.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: The exported metric-definition type now requires the observation key to be a string. Compile-time assertions reject consumers where that field is missing, optional, unknown, or merely present in an untyped record, and a runtime test reads the field from a validated metric. No prose text is frozen or compared by digest.
rationale: The implementation changes two paths inside the recorded scope, but it enforces a public TypeScript field contract rather than duplicating prose into a digest-based validator. The compile-time consumer and runtime read clearly stay outside the ruled-out approach.
